ARRIVAL INSTRUCTIONS

How to Get to Can Picornell

Detailed instructions and visual references to reach the villa without any trouble.

Official Address

Av. del Cid, 481, 07198 Palma, Balearic Islands, Spain
⚠️ Important Information about the Address:
The side entrance street leading to the villa does not have an official house number. For this reason, set your GPS navigation to Avenida del Cid, 481 (which is the corner house next to the entrance street).

Direct GPS Navigation

Click to open the route directly on your phone's navigation system to the entrance corner:

Open in Google Maps Open in Apple Maps

Step-by-Step Visual Guide

1

Step 1: Turn at the Corner of Avenida del Cid, 481

Drive to Avenida del Cid, 481. When you reach the corner house (you will see number 481 on the wall), leave the main road and turn into the side street following the arrow.

2

Step 2: Main Entrance to Can Picornell

Continue straight along the side street for about 220 meters. Just before reaching the end of the road, on your right-hand side, you will see the large black metal entrance gate of Can Picornell with its stone sign post.
